headline: Elevated outlook for long outages in Hidalgo County
summary: Homes in Hidalgo County lose power for 12 hours or more about once every 10 years. That comes from 8 years of records since 2018. The largest outage here began on February 14, 2021. At its peak, 16% of homes in the county were dark. For a home with electric heat, one Core lasts about 18 hours in June and about 32 hours in March. We suggest two Cores. That would have covered 77% of past long outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
